streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: All reagents dissolved together. Concentration set to 0.1 M based on batch standard and engineering calculations.

mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: Reagents are dissolved together before irradiation, suggesting simultaneous mixing. Single stream requires no complex mixing, but a T-mixer is standard for connecting pump to reactor coil.
pre_reactor_steps: Deoxygenation via sparging with inert gas (N2 or Ar) or degassing membrane to remove O2, as radical reactions are inhibited by oxygen (Chemistry Plan).
post_reactor_steps: Collection of product solution. Workup involves removal of succinimide byproduct (standard for NBS reactions).
chemistry_notes: Radical bromination using NBS and UV light. Carbon tetrachloride is toxic; ensure closed system. FEP tubing used for UV transparency. Residence time reduced from 8h (batch) to 16 min (flow) based on kinetic intensification factor of 30x. Da=1.25 suggests mixing is significant but manageable with laminar flow in 1mm ID tubing.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculation Step 2: tau = 16.0 min. Batch was 8h. Flow advantage factor 30x applied. Range [10.7-24.0] min.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Single phase liquid system. Basis is liquid volume / liquid flow.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Same as batch (30 C). Calculation Step 8 confirms thermal safety (Da_th << 1).
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation Step 8: BPR not required. T=30C is well below bp of CCl4 (76.7C).
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: FEP selected for UV transparency (Photocatalysis rule) and chemical compatibility with CCl4.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Calculation Step 1: C0 = 0.1 M. Standard for radical halogenations to control exotherm and light penetration.
